prompts: Create a production 2x2 animation POSE SHEET of the EXACT Iron Legionary from reference. FOUR cells equal size with wide TRANSPARENT gutters, NO grid/labels/background. EACH figure entire body and all sword/shield contained within its own cell. Same physical body scale in all cells, SAME head/armor/black swept horns/red skin/charcoal hooked plates/oxblood cloth. Sword ALWAYS in character RIGHT hand (viewer-left at neutral), tall pointed demonic shield ALWAYS LEFT hand, same shield red diagonal stripe. Never duplicate, swap or remove gear. Angular refined 2D Runelord rendering EXACTLY reference. All face, limbs, equipment drawn in proper action poses; no copied static pose. Feet at same ground line per cell, generous space for weapon extension. Minimal VFX, only existing orange-red sword runes. POSES reading order: top-left windup, knees slightly bent, right sword arm draws blade back raised behind shoulder, left shield forward protects torso; top-right strike, torso pivots toward right and right sword arm executes clear forward downward slash to right, shield left arm remains guarding, both hands correctly attached; bottom-left follow-through and recovery, sword extended low-right then returning, firm feet; bottom-right HIT RECOIL, torso pulls back from frontal blow, chin tucked, shield shoved toward torso, sword arm lowered but still grips sword. No attack trails obscuring hands. Keep body size identical.
